title: Prime Minister shares an article by Union Minister Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan highlighting the role of technology and research in transforming agriculture and improving farmers' lives
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared an article written by Union Minister, Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan.
In the article, Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan writes that technology and research are central to transforming Indian agriculture and improving farmers' lives. It highlights the importance of nutrition security, with a greater focus on high-value crops, climate-resilient farming, efficient use of resources and better market access for farmers.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X:
“Union Minister Shri @ChouhanShivraj writes that technology and research are central to transforming Indian agriculture and improving farmers' lives.
He highlights the importance of nutrition security, with greater focus on high-value crops, climate-resilient farming, efficient use of resources and better market access for farmers.
